title: Gefaari Drokaz
summary: Gefaari Drokaz layers chants, breaths and minions as his health falls.
overview: Gefaari Drokaz layers chants, breaths and minions as his health falls.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign minion control and save defensive coverage for the overlapping late-stage spell cycles.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 90% health, repeated deathly chants begin; at 85%, the lava-breath cycle begins.
At 60%, two minions join and a discord cloud cycle starts.
At 30%, three more minions join with faster breath and panic pressure.
At 25%, another three minions arrive and the boss changes melee tuning.

notes: Approval E375. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
